description: Exposition de l'Aquitaine aux risques naturels majeurs - Aléa "Rupture de barrage" is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by aquitaine.fr. Map showing the exposure of Aquitaine to the "Rupture de barrage" hazard. MAJ 03/09/2012. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Aquitaine Exposure to Major Natural Hazards - Aléa "Dam Break"" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include cartothèque, Rupture de barrage, inspire. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
